goal: Frozen-checkpoint OOD transfer to genuine public sequential RTL; no new synthetic training
training: none; reuse closure/results_v1_1 weights and exact old training vocab
data: 10 fixed source files; one backward D-cone per synchronous dff group; all Q boundaries cut, formal equivalence to mapped combinational cone
metrics: RTL-to-netlist Recall@1/5 and MRR among distinct new real cones
summary: Human model-authored per-design descriptions, before metrics; shared for registers in same design; not GPT pipeline or independently validated summaries
exclusions: async FF, unsupported cells, undriven/X cone outputs, size caps; record all, no result-based exclusions
interpretation: real open regression examples not industrial corpus; frozen transfer not closer Graphormer training; no PPA; multiple registers are clustered under source families
